snake `core.BaselineMeans` sample. Each test captures the matplotlib figure `learning_curve`
saves and checks it against a rule from `.claude/skills/dataviz` (SKILL.md, references/
marks-and-anatomy.md, references/anti-patterns.md), including the skill's own palette
validator (scripts/validate_palette.py).
"""

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
CONTRACTS = ROOT / "tests" / "contracts"
DATAVIZ = ROOT / ".claude" / "skills" / "dataviz"

# marks-and-anatomy.md: lines are 2px (thin marks); gridlines and axes are 1px hairlines.
LINE_WIDTH_RANGE = (1.0, 2.5)
HAIRLINE_MAX = 1.0
# marks-and-anatomy.md: an area fill is the series hue at ~10% opacity, a wash.
WASH_ALPHA_MAX = 0.25
# SKILL.md: a 9th categorical hue is never generated.
MAX_CATEGORICAL = 8
# Below this OKLCH chroma a colour is a neutral (de-emphasis gray), not a categorical hue.
NEUTRAL_CHROMA = 0.03
SOLID = {"-", "solid"}
NOT_SANS = {"serif", "cursive", "fantasy", "monospace"}


def _load(name: str, path: Path) -> Any:
    if name not in sys.modules:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
        assert spec is not None
        assert spec.loader is not None
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return sys.modules[name]


def kit() -> Any:
    return _load("contracts_kit", CONTRACTS / "kit.py")


def validator() -> Any:
    return _load("dataviz_validate_palette", DATAVIZ / "scripts" / "validate_palette.py")


@pytest.fixture
def saved(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> list[Figure]:
    """Every figure saved while the test runs (pyplot.savefig goes through Figure.savefig)."""
    figures: list[Figure] = []
    original: Callable[..., Any] = Figure.savefig

    def record(self: Figure, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        figures.append(self)
        return original(self, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Figure, "savefig", record)
    return figures


def draw(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> tuple[Output, Figure]:
    runs = kit().fake("runlog.find_runs")(tmp_path, "snake", "default")
    means = kit().sample("core.BaselineMeans", "snake")
    out = tmp_path / "reports" / "snake" / "learning-curve.png"
    chart = learning_curve(runs, means, out)
    assert saved, "learning_curve saved no matplotlib figure"
    return chart, saved[-1]


def plot_axes(fig: Figure) -> list[Axes]:
    axes = [ax for ax in fig.axes if ax.get_lines() or ax.collections]
    assert axes, "the chart has no axes with data on them"
    return axes


def data_lines(fig: Figure) -> list[Line2D]:
    return [line for ax in plot_axes(fig) for line in ax.get_lines() if line.get_visible()]


def bands(fig: Figure) -> list[PolyCollection]:
    return [c for ax in plot_axes(fig) for c in ax.collections if isinstance(c, PolyCollection)]


def visible_texts(fig: Figure) -> list[Text]:
    found = fig.findobj(lambda a: isinstance(a, Text) and a.get_visible())
    return [t for t in found if isinstance(t, Text) and t.get_text().strip()]


def line_hexes(fig: Figure) -> list[str]:
    ordered: dict[str, None] = {}
    for line in data_lines(fig):
        ordered.setdefault(to_hex(line.get_color()), None)
    return list(ordered)


def categorical(fig: Figure) -> list[str]:
    check = validator()
    return [c for c in line_hexes(fig) if check.oklch(c)[1] >= NEUTRAL_CHROMA]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_chart_is_written_as_a_chart_output(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> None:
    chart, _ = draw(tmp_path, saved)
    assert chart.kind == "chart"
    assert chart.path.is_file()
    assert chart.path.read_bytes()[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_one_y_axis_per_plot_never_dual_axis(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> None:
    _, fig = draw(tmp_path, saved)
    positions = [tuple(np.round(ax.get_position().bounds, 6)) for ax in fig.axes]
    assert len(positions) == len(set(positions)), "two y-scales share one plot (twinx)"


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_two_or_more_series_carry_a_legend(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> None:
    _, fig = draw(tmp_path, saved)
    for ax in plot_axes(fig):
        series = len(ax.get_lines()) + len(ax.collections)
        assert series >= 2
        legends = [leg for leg in [ax.get_legend(), *fig.legends] if leg is not None]
        assert legends, "a chart with 2+ series has no legend"
        labels = [t.get_text() for leg in legends for t in leg.get_texts()]
        assert len([lab for lab in labels if lab.strip()]) >= 2


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_axes_and_title_are_labelled(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> None:

    suptitle = fig.get_suptitle() if hasattr(fig, "get_suptitle") else ""

@pytest.mark.intent
def test_lines_are_thin_with_round_caps_and_joins(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> None:
    _, fig = draw(tmp_path, saved)
    lines = data_lines(fig)
    assert len(lines) >= 3, "a mean line and two baseline lines per team"
    low, high = LINE_WIDTH_RANGE
    for line in lines:
        assert low <= line.get_linewidth() <= high, line.get_label()
        if line.get_linestyle() in SOLID:
            assert line.get_solid_capstyle() == "round", line.get_label()
            assert line.get_solid_joinstyle() == "round", line.get_label()


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_min_max_band_is_a_wash_of_its_series_hue(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> None:
    _, fig = draw(tmp_path, saved)
    found = bands(fig)
    assert found, "no min-max band"
    hues = {to_hex(line.get_color()) for line in data_lines(fig)}
    for band in found:
        faces = to_rgba_array(band.get_facecolor())
        assert len(faces) >= 1
        assert 0.0 < float(faces[:, 3].max()) <= WASH_ALPHA_MAX
        assert {to_hex(face, keep_alpha=False) for face in faces} <= hues

@pytest.mark.intent

    texts = visible_texts(fig)

@pytest.mark.intent
def test_gridlines_and_spines_are_solid_hairlines(tmp_path: Path, saved: list[Figure]) -> None:
    _, fig = draw(tmp_path, saved)
    for ax in plot_axes(fig):
        for axis in (ax.xaxis, ax.yaxis):
            for grid in axis.get_gridlines():
                if grid.get_visible():
                    assert grid.get_linestyle() in SOLID
                    assert grid.get_linewidth() <= HAIRLINE_MAX
        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            if spine.get_visible():
                assert spine.get_linestyle() in SOLID
                assert spine.get_linewidth() <= HAIRLINE_MAX

"""Learning curves with a min-max band and baseline lines (LOG-03 to LOG-05)."""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from matplotlib.axes import Axes
from matplotlib.figure import Figure
from numpy.typing import NDArray

from rllab.core import BaselineMeans, Output, WorldSpec
from rllab.runlog import Run

STEPS_LABEL = "environment steps"
# The dataviz skill's reference palette (light mode): categorical slot 1 and the chart chrome.
SERIES = "#2a78d6"
SURFACE = "#fcfcfb"
INK = "#0b0b0b"
SECONDARY = "#52514e"
MUTED = "#898781"
GRID = "#e1e0d9"
AXIS = "#c3c2b7"


def learning_curve(
    runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: BaselineMeans, out: Path, *, measure: str | None = None
) -> Output:
    figure = draw_curves(runs, baselines, measure)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure.savefig(out)
    figure.savefig(out.with_suffix(".svg"))
    return Output(out, "chart", tuple(run.record.config.name for run in runs))


def draw_curves(runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: BaselineMeans, measure: str | None) -> Figure:
    """One panel per team (or one for `measure`): mean line, min-max band, baseline lines."""
    if not runs:
        raise ValueError("no runs to chart")
    spec = runs[0].record.spec
    panels = _panels(spec, measure)
    figure = Figure(figsize=(6.4 * len(panels), 4.2), facecolor=SURFACE, layout="constrained")
    axes = figure.subplots(1, len(panels), squeeze=False)[0]
    for ax, (team, label) in zip(axes, panels, strict=True):
        steps, values = _series(runs, team, measure)
        _draw_band(ax, steps, values, f"{team}: {label}, {len(runs)} runs")
        if measure is None:
            _draw_baselines(ax, baselines, team)
        _style(ax, label)
    return figure


def _panels(spec: WorldSpec, measure: str | None) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """(team, y-axis label) per panel: each team's score, or the declared measure's team."""
    if measure is None:
        return [(team.name, team.score_name) for team in spec.teams]
    declared = [m for m in spec.measures if m.name == measure]
    if not declared:
        raise ValueError(f"{spec.world} declares no measure {measure!r}")
    return [(declared[0].team, measure)]


def _series(
    runs: Sequence[Run], team: str, measure: str | None
) -> tuple[NDArray[np.int64], NDArray[np.float64]]:
    """The evaluation steps every run has, and each run's value there (runs x steps)."""
    by_run = [
        {p.step: p.scores[team] if measure is None else p.measures[measure] for p in run.evals()}
        for run in runs
    ]
    steps = sorted(set.intersection(*(set(values) for values in by_run)))
    rows = [[values[step] for step in steps] for values in by_run]
    return np.array(steps, dtype=np.int64), np.array(rows, dtype=np.float64)


def _draw_band(ax: Axes, steps: NDArray[np.int64], values: NDArray[np.float64], title: str) -> None:
    ax.fill_between(
        steps,
        values.min(axis=0),
        values.max(axis=0),
        color=SERIES,
        alpha=0.18,
        linewidth=0,
        label="min-max range",
    )
    ax.plot(steps, values.mean(axis=0), color=SERIES, linewidth=2, label="mean")
    ax.set_title(title, color=INK, loc="left")


def _draw_baselines(ax: Axes, baselines: BaselineMeans, team: str) -> None:
    """Both baselines' mean scores as labelled horizontal reference lines."""
    lines = (
        (baselines.random[team], "random play", "--", MUTED),
        (baselines.rule[team], "rule-based", ":", SECONDARY),
    )
    for value, label, style, color in lines:
        ax.axhline(value, color=color, linestyle=style, linewidth=1.5, label=label)
        ax.annotate(
            label,
            (1.0, value),
            xycoords=("axes fraction", "data"),
            xytext=(-4, 4),
            textcoords="offset points",
            ha="right",
            color=SECONDARY,
            fontsize=8,
        )


def _style(ax: Axes, label: str) -> None:
    ax.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    ax.set_xlabel(STEPS_LABEL, color=SECONDARY)
    ax.set_ylabel(label, color=SECONDARY)
    ax.grid(color=GRID, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.tick_params(colors=MUTED)
    for side in ("top", "right"):
        ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)
    for side in ("left", "bottom"):
        ax.spines[side].set_color(AXIS)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, labelcolor=SECONDARY, fontsize=8, loc="upper left")
